description: Verify an Italian counterparty in one call before invoicing or paying: partita IVA / codice fiscale check digit, IndicePA public-administration record (name, category, institutional PEC, address) and the e-invoicing offices that receive FatturaPA via SDI (codice univoco ufficio, start date, PEC). Returns verdict pa_verificata | formato_valido_non_verificato | formato_non_valido with sources and CC BY 4.0 attribution. Public-administration data only: private companies are not confirmed (no VIES, no company PEC). Malformed input, a wrong check digit or an IndicePA outage are not charged. Costs $0.01 in USDC (or 0.01 EURC) on Base via x402.

id.description: Italian partita IVA or numeric codice fiscale (11 digits, optional IT prefix), e.g. 80016350821
